name: no-catch-ignore
description: Disallow an empty catch block — it swallows every failure, including the ones nobody anticipated, and turns a code regression into silence
fixHint: Catch only what you expect (inspect the error code and rethrow the rest), or return the failure as a value. If ignoring a specific failure is genuinely correct, name it in the block: `catch (error) { if (!isMissing(error)) throw error; }`.
